name: Tetrahedral Normal Estimation
definition: Approximates the surface normal at a point p on the zero-isosurface of a distance field by sampling the distance field at four equidistant vertices of a tetrahedron centered at p, calculating directional derivatives, and summing them.
summary: Tetrahedral Normal Estimation approximates SDF surface normals using four distance evaluations, reducing computational cost by 33% compared to standard central differences while maintaining comparable accuracy.
